_readme: Each entry has a game message (shown in Minecraft chat) and a tg message (sent to Telegram). The tg field is optional; if omitted, the game message is used. To add a line, provide the text fields and leave out 'used'. Telegram messages have been adapted to match the tone of in-game messages, with roast and mysterious-behavior categories included.
